text:
(2) Details do not have to be given under this section to the extent that they have already
been given under section 6A(2).

(3) The accused must give a notice under this section during the period which, by virtue
of section 12, is the relevant period for this section.

(4) If, following the giving of a notice under this section, the accused—
(a) decides to call a person (other than himself) who is not included in the notice
as a proposed witness, or decides not to call a person who is so included, or
(b) discovers any information which, under subsection (1), he would have had to
include in the notice if he had been aware of it when giving the notice,
he must give an appropriately amended notice to the court and the prosecutor.]
